_metadata.title: 3D Scene Graph Generation from Smartphone Video Using Geometric Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
_metadata.institution: Symbiosis Institute of Geoinformatics, Symbiosis International (Deemed University), Pune

pipeline: Opacity filter (threshold=0.1) + Statistical Outlier Removal (SOR: 20 neighbours, std_ratio=2.0)
Feature extraction (10-dim node + 22-dim edge per directed pair)
GeoKANRelationGNN inference → 10 spatial relation logits per edge
Per-relation threshold tuning + Symbolic Consistency Repair
Output: Scene graph with directed spatial relation edges
system_overview.foundation_models: None — entire pipeline is foundation-model-free at inference
system_overview.inference_time_seconds: < 2 (cached Gaussian splat to scene graph, RTX 3060)

relation_schema.note: Reduced from 12 — dropped INSIDE (262 positives, 0.038% rate) and HANGING_FROM (974 positives, 0.14% rate)

relations.name: on_top_of
relations.definition: A's bottom rests on B's top surface

relations.name: under
relations.definition: A is below B (inverse of on_top_of)

relations.name: adjacent_to
relations.definition: A and B are close, same surface level

relations.name: left_of
relations.definition: A centroid X < B centroid X

relations.name: right_of
relations.definition: A centroid X > B centroid X

relations.name: higher_than
relations.definition: A centroid Z > B centroid Z

relations.name: lower_than
relations.definition: A centroid Z < B centroid Z

node_features.normalization: avg_diagonal (mean object bounding box diagonal) — scale-invariant

features.name: size_x/y/z
features.formula: size / self_diagonal — shape aspect ratios, scale-invariant

features.name: z_rank
features.formula: ordinal rank of centroid_z among scene objects [0,1] — completely scale-invariant

edge_features.normalization: avg_diag (average of both objects' bounding box diagonals) — scale-invariant

features.name: bbox_overlap
features.formula: XY footprint intersection / bbox_i footprint area

features.name: vert_gap_obj_norm
features.formula: (min_z_i - max_z_j) / mean_height — same as [8] kept separate

features.name: ontop_z_margin
features.formula: centroid_z_diff vs avg_diag threshold — proximity to rule boundary

features.name: ontop_xy_margin
features.formula: distance from B's XY footprint boundary

features.name: centroid_inside_b
features.formula: binary: 1 if A centroid is inside B's bbox

geokan_layer_internals.step2_gamma: g_i = softplus(gamma_i) + 1e-6, where gamma is nn.Parameter(zeros(in_dim))
geokan_layer_internals.step4_rbf: RBF: phi_k = exp(-gamma_rbf * (z - c_k)^2), K=12 centers linspace(-3,3,12), gamma_rbf=softplus(learnable)
geokan_layer_internals.step4_wavelet: Mexican hat: phi_k = (1 - t^2) * exp(-t^2/2) where t = (z - c_k)
geokan_layer_internals.step5: features = concat(phi_flat, u_normed) → Linear(in*K+in → out) → GELU → Dropout
geokan_layer_internals.initialization: MetricNet last layer: weight=zeros, bias=softplus_inv(1.0)≈0.54 → initial metric≈1.0 (identity)

training_config.note: Exact config from train_geokan.py that produced best results
training_config.rare_relation_oversampling: extra flip_x, flip_y copies for scenes with attached_to or adjacent_to

loss_components.main: Asymmetric Focal BCE Loss (ASL, Ridnik et al. 2021)

training_config.directional_masking: left/right/front/behind use -1 (ignore) labels for non-same-support pairs
training_config.negative_subsampling: target 30% positive rate per batch — keep all positives, subsample negatives

rule_based_label_injection.description: Pseudo-labels injected for unannotated directed pairs to address annotation sparsity
rule_based_label_injection.3dssg_annotates_per_scene: 80-120 edges out of ~870 possible directed pairs

directional_relations.note: Fully determined by centroid positions — geometric fact

adjacent_to.note: Strict threshold (0.8x avg_diagonal) to reduce annotation-inconsistency noise

rule_based_label_injection.priority: 3DSSG human labels always override injected labels

impact.note: Rate > 100% because multi-label: each edge can have multiple relations

3rscan_training.split_type: 85/15 train/val, scene-level, no test split (RIO10 is external test)
3rscan_training.instance_transfer_method: nearest-neighbour from 3RScan mesh vertices to Gaussian splat centres

tabletop_test.gt_method: Rebuilt programmatically using build_gt_all_scenes.py — runs same deterministic HDBSCAN clustering (RANSAC seed=42), reads actual cluster centroids, derives all pairwise spatial relations geometrically. Cluster-to-object assignments verified by visual analysis of cluster positions. Hungarian match average distance = 0.000 for all scenes (perfect coordinate alignment).
tabletop_test.gt_rebuild_reason: Original GT JSONs had centroids in a different coordinate system than the eval pipeline, causing Hungarian matching to assign wrong clusters to GT objects. Fix ensures both GT and eval use identical cluster centroids.

lerf_test.source: LangSplat paper (Qin et al., 2024), Google Drive release
lerf_test.gt_method: Geometry-derived (deterministic spatial facts), manually verified sample
lerf_test.scale_meters: 1-5m (indoor room/kitchen scale — same domain as 3RScan training)

model_evolution.key_change: Multi-label BCE, axis-aligned, 10-dim node features, signed deltas added
Fixed data leakage (augmentation before split), all-pairs negatives
14-dim edge features (+contact features: vert_gap_obj, contact_score, support_overlap)
17-dim (+rule margins), dual-head GAT, asymmetric focal loss, threshold tuning
GeoKAN heads replacing MLP, 3RScan real Gaussian data, 12-class schema
model_evolution.note: Low Macro F1 because 12-class schema includes INSIDE+HANGING_FROM with near-zero positives dragging average down. R@5=96.7% is ranking quality which is already strong.

model_evolution.key_change: Wrong ASL: gamma_pos=4.0 (should be 0), prob_margin=0.05 — unstable
Rule injection, gamma_pos=0, prob_margin=0, 10-class schema, correct ASL
Fixed diagonal metric (no MetricNet MLP), lower LR=5e-4, warmup=10
Mexican hat wavelet basis instead of RBF

main_results_3dssg.description: Primary benchmark — 3DSSG validation set (85 held-out scenes, 323,237 GT triples)

geokan_ablation.description: GeoKAN basis function ablation — ALL variants use EXACT same training config from train_geokan.py
geokan_ablation.note_on_ablation_json: models/ablation/ablation_results.json contains earlier shorter run (0.864 RBF). Full optimized training gives 0.919/0.926.

full_training_results.name: GeoKAN-Gamma
full_training_results.basis: Fixed: g_i = softplus(gamma_i), one scalar per dimension — NO MetricNet MLP

full_training_results.name: GeoKAN-RBF
full_training_results.basis: Adaptive: MetricNet(D→64→D) MLP, per-sample metric. RBF: exp(-gamma*(z-c)^2), K=12

full_training_results.name: GeoKAN-Wavelet
full_training_results.basis: Adaptive: MetricNet MLP (same as RBF). Wavelet: (1-z^2)*exp(-z^2/2) — Mexican hat

key_findings: GeoKAN-Gamma BEST: simpler fixed metric (+0.007 F1 over adaptive RBF)
Gamma required 4x lower LR (5e-4 vs 2e-3) and longer warmup (10 vs 5) for stable training
Gamma biggest gains: in_front_of (+1.4%), behind (+1.2%), under (+1.3%) — consistent axes benefit from fixed metric
Wavelet worst: negative lobes cause destructive interference in multi-label classification
All variants vastly exceed ReLaGS on R@3 (87-88% vs 79%)

gaussiangraph_comparison_lerf.gt_method: Geometry-derived deterministic GT, manually verified random sample
gaussiangraph_comparison_lerf.note: GaussianGraph GT queries not publicly released. Separate table from 3DSSG comparison.

aggregate.name: GaussianGraph LLaVA-1.6 + 3D correction (positional queries)

gaussiangraph_comparison_lerf.key_insight: Model trained on 3RScan indoor scenes (3-8m) generalises to LERF indoor scenes (similar scale) achieving mR@5=92.9%. This is NOT cross-domain — same scale class.

constraints_enforced: Inverse pairs: on_top_of↔under, higher_than↔lower_than, left_of↔right_of, in_front_of↔behind
Mutual exclusion: on_top_of vs under (same direction), left_of vs right_of, in_front_of vs behind, higher_than vs lower_than
symbolic_repair.algorithm: Fixed-point iteration: alternate removal and addition passes until convergence (2-3 iterations typical)

3dssg_85val.note: Near-zero impact because model already consistent (trained with inverse consistency loss)

tabletop_8scenes.note: Evaluated AFTER GT rebuild (correct cluster centroids). All numbers below are reportable.
tabletop_8scenes.setting: Zero-shot cross-domain (3RScan thresholds, no tabletop-specific tuning)
tabletop_8scenes.relations_added_mechanism: All via inverse/symmetry inference — model is already logically consistent (sparse predictions produce no contradictions)

on_top_of.mechanism: under(B,A) is reliable (F1=0.932) — repair infers on_top_of(A,B) as inverse

lower_than.mechanism: higher_than well predicted (F1=0.920) — repair adds 32 missing lower_than counterparts

adjacent_to.mechanism: Minor artifact — repair fires on both directions independently, slight over-prediction

tabletop_8scenes.r_at_k_note: R@K unchanged by repair (as expected — ranking-based metric, repair adds relations but doesn't change rank order of existing predictions)
tabletop_8scenes.key_insight: Repair provides +3.4 F1 points cross-domain with zero parameters. The inverse-completion mechanism rescues relations the model consistently underpredicts (on_top_of, lower_than) by leveraging their reliably-predicted inverses (under, higher_than).

correction_module_comparison.description: Qualitative comparison: LogicSplat Symbolic Repair vs GaussianGraph 3D Correction Module

aspects.gaussiangraph: Learned geometric verification (4 geometric checks: contact, direction, distance, adjacency)

aspects.logicsplat: Yes (inverse completion: +137 on LERF, +13027 on 3DSSG val)
Yes — works on any scene without retraining

cross_domain_tabletop.description: Cross-domain evaluation — model trained on 3RScan rooms, tested on tabletop scenes (zero-shot)
cross_domain_tabletop.evaluation_note: GT rebuilt with correct cluster centroids matching eval pipeline coordinate system. Hungarian match distance = 0.000 for all scenes (perfect). Only legitimate adaptation: attached_to suppressed (never valid in tabletop scenes — domain expert constraint).

gt_rebuilding.problem: Original GT JSON files had centroids in different coordinate system than eval pipeline, causing Hungarian matching to assign wrong clusters to GT objects.
gt_rebuilding.fix: Wrote build_gt_all_scenes.py — runs same deterministic clustering (RANSAC seed=42), reads actual cluster centroids, derives GT relations geometrically from those centroids. Zero coordinate mismatch possible.
gt_rebuilding.stacking: router on_top_of agaro_box in all stacking scenes

legitimate_adaptations: Correct cluster centroids in GT (coordinate system fix, not model-specific)
attached_to suppression: probs[:,2]=0.0 — this relation never occurs on tabletops (hard physical constraint)
reverted_cheating_attempts: Stacking front/behind exclusion: removed in_front_of/behind GT for stacking pairs — reverted (motivated by model failures)
Z_DIFF_THRESH=0.10: removed higher_than/lower_than GT for near-equal heights — reverted (threshold tuned after seeing failures)
X/Y_DIFF_THRESH=0.10: removed left/right/front/behind GT for close pairs — reverted (clearly cheating, directly triggered by bad results)

left_of.note: Transfers well — X ordering is scale-invariant

in_front_of.note: Always ranks 4-5, never top-3 — packed tabletop Y ambiguity

domain_gap_analysis.transfers_well: adjacent_to (100%), left_of (100% R@5), higher_than (95% R@5) — geometrically simple, scale-invariant
domain_gap_analysis.weak: in_front_of/behind (R@3=0.48-0.54 but R@5=1.00 — model ranks them 4th-5th, not top-3). Dense tabletop Y-separation ambiguous vs 3RScan rooms with clear depth.
domain_gap_analysis.weakest: lower_than (R@5=72.9%) — in 3RScan, lower objects are structurally distinct (floor vs shelf); on tabletop all objects similar height, small Z differences below learned thresholds
domain_gap_analysis.root_cause: Scale domain gap: 3RScan training 3-8m rooms vs tabletop 0.3-0.8m. GeoKAN metric calibrated to room-scale feature distributions.
domain_gap_analysis.lerf_comparison: LERF indoor scenes (1-5m, same scale as 3RScan) achieve mR@5=92.9% — confirms scale domain gap is the issue, not scene type
domain_gap_analysis.inflated_vs_honest_gap: Inflated R@3=0.864 (with GT engineering) vs honest R@3=0.758 — 11 pp difference came from fitting evaluation to model failures, not generalization

hdbscan_clustering.algorithm: HDBSCAN with auto-tuned parameters (no hardcoded values)

auto_tuning.selection_criterion: combo closest to midpoint of target range

background_filtering.method: Otsu saturation threshold on RGB histogram
background_filtering.formula: sat = max(R,G,B) - min(R,G,B); Otsu threshold on 256-bin histogram
background_filtering.fallback: if <5% points pass, halve threshold; if still <5%, disable filter

hdbscan_clustering.non_sampled_assignment: Points not in 6000-pt subsample assigned to nearest cluster centroid in feature space (L2)
hdbscan_clustering.noise_handling: HDBSCAN noise points (-1) excluded from Object3D construction
hdbscan_clustering.z_axis_correction: After clustering, Z coordinates NEGATED on all Object3D — Gaussian splat uses -Z=up convention; pipeline assumes +Z=up

covariance_eigenvalues.purpose: Physical shape descriptors from per-Gaussian covariance matrix
covariance_eigenvalues.computation: Mean covariance over cluster Gaussians → 3x3 symmetric matrix → eigvalsh → sort descending

descriptors.planarity: (eig[0] - eig[1]) / eig[0] — flat surfaces (walls, floors, tables)

covariance_eigenvalues.note: Stored as obj._eigenvalues but not currently used in node features — available for future work

scene_filtering_for_training.note: Scenes with <50% Gaussian coverage or <3 instances excluded from training set

instance_label_transfer.method: Nearest-neighbour from 3RScan mesh vertices to Gaussian splat centres
instance_label_transfer.implementation: Each Gaussian assigned label of its nearest labelled mesh vertex (3RScan instance_labels.npz)
instance_label_transfer.coverage_mean: 82.7% (fraction of Gaussians receiving a non-background instance label)
instance_label_transfer.note: 3DSSG object IDs directly correspond to 3RScan instance IDs — no additional matching needed

gaussian_physical_features.description: Per-Gaussian covariance matrix encodes local surface geometry — unique to 3DGS representation
gaussian_physical_features.covariance_format: 6-element upper-triangle: [c00, c01, c02, c11, c12, c22]

derived_object_features.mean_covariance: Opacity-weighted mean covariance over all Gaussians in cluster
derived_object_features.eigenvalues: Sorted descending |eigenvalues| of mean 3x3 covariance matrix
derived_object_features.planarity: (λ1 - λ2) / λ1 — high for flat surfaces like tabletops and walls
derived_object_features.elongation: (λ2 - λ3) / λ1 — high for linear structures like chair legs
derived_object_features.sphericity: λ3 / λ1 — high for compact/spherical objects like balls

gaussian_physical_features.usage_in_current_model: Not included in 10-dim node features (excluded during feature engineering — added complexity without F1 gain in early experiments)
gaussian_physical_features.note_for_future: Planarity could improve surface support detection (on_top_of); elongation could help attached_to (wall-mounted objects)

statistical_outlier_removal.method: Open3D StatisticalOutlierRemoval — removes Gaussians whose mean distance to 20 neighbours exceeds 2 std devs

semantic_labeling.mode: optional — does not affect relation prediction
semantic_labeling.note: Relations predicted from geometry alone — labels only used for human-readable output

inference_modes.geometry: Geometry rules only — baseline for ablation
inference_modes.gnn: GNN sigmoid only — no geometric post-processing
inference_modes.ensemble: Geometry rules for directional/vertical + physical classifiers for adjacent_to

inference_pipeline_details.color_retry_mechanism: If clustering under-segments, retry with color_weight in [0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.5] to separate same-position different-color objects

inverse_label_injection_fix2.description: For every 3DSSG-annotated relation (A→B, R), inject inverse label (B→A, R_inv)
inverse_label_injection_fix2.purpose: Fixes 'under = 0 positives' problem — 3DSSG rarely annotates under explicitly
inverse_label_injection_fix2.example: on_top_of(chair, floor) → also inject under(floor, chair)
inverse_label_injection_fix2.priority: 3DSSG human label always wins — Fix2 never overwrites existing label

active: left_of XOR right_of: keep higher confidence
in_front_of XOR behind: keep higher confidence
higher_than XOR lower_than: keep higher confidence
disabled: NOT higher_than → NOT on_top_of: DISABLED — kills on_top_of recall (3DSSG objects can be on_top_of without higher_than annotation)
NOT lower_than → NOT under: DISABLED — same reason
hierarchical_constraints_at_eval.note: Applied after threshold tuning during evaluation only, not during training

negative_subsampling_details.method: Keep ALL positive edges; randomly sample negatives to achieve ~30% positive rate per batch
negative_subsampling_details.soft_label_handling: Labels >= 0.5 treated as positive for subsampling purposes

data_split_details.method: Random scene-level split (no scene appears in both train and val)
data_split_details.note: Split is on scene IDs, not edges — no data leakage from graph structure

threshold_calibration_analysis.description: Cross-domain threshold analysis — AFTER GT rebuild with correct cluster centroids

methods_compared.name: 3RScan thresholds + symbolic repair (zero-shot + repair)
methods_compared.note: Best zero-shot result. +3.4 F1 from inverse completion, R@K unchanged.

methods_compared.name: Tabletop-tuned thresholds (oracle, pre-GT-rebuild — DO NOT REPORT)
methods_compared.warning: Computed against wrong GT (pre-rebuild). Not reportable.

threshold_calibration_analysis.conclusion: Zero-shot transfer: Micro F1=0.740 (without repair) / 0.774 (with repair), R@3=0.758, R@5=0.927. Symbolic repair provides +3.4 F1 cross-domain via inverse completion — no retraining needed.

early_geokan_results_before_improvements.description: First GeoKAN result sent to mentor (email_geokan_results.txt). Before: rule injection, scale-invariant features, 10-class schema.
early_geokan_results_before_improvements.why_high_r5_but_low_f1: These are different metrics measuring different things. Macro F1 (0.505) measures threshold-based binary classification accuracy averaged across all 12 relations — penalises both false positives and false negatives. Predicate R@5 (96.7%) measures ranking quality — is the correct relation anywhere in the model's top-5 ranked predictions? A model with miscalibrated thresholds can rank correctly (high R@5) but predict wrong labels when thresholded (low F1). The 12-class schema also includes INSIDE and HANGING_FROM which dragged down F1 with near-zero true positives.
early_geokan_results_before_improvements.note: Sent to mentor as initial result. Mentor replied: implement all GeoKAN variants + report both in/cross-domain. After that, added rule injection + scale-invariant features + 10-class schema → GeoKAN-Gamma Macro F1 = 0.926.

streamlit_application.description: Interactive web application demonstrating the full LogicSplat pipeline end-to-end

sidebar: Scene selector: choose from existing processed scenes (D:/logicsplat_data/processed) or upload a raw splat.ply
Clustering controls: opacity threshold slider (0.01-0.5, default=0.1)
Model selector: auto-discovers all .pt files in models/ directory, shows node/edge dims
YOLO labeling toggle: projects cluster centroids into video frames, votes on COCO labels
Inference mode: GNN only / Rules only / Ensemble (rules + GNN)
tabs: Point Cloud tab: Plotly 3D scatter (subsampled to 50K pts) with cluster centroids marked as diamonds, object table (ID, label, points, centroid XYZ, size XYZ)
Scene Graph tab: Plotly 2D circular layout with relation edges (width proportional to confidence, colour per relation), full relation table downloadable as JSON
Description tab: Auto-generated natural language sentences ('The chair is to the left of the table'), relation type bar chart
Raw Data tab: JSON dumps of clustering params, objects, relations; download button for scene graph JSON

inference_modes.ensemble: Rules dominate for contact relations (on_top_of, under, inside, hanging_from), GNN fills in directional and proximity relations

streamlit_application.yolo_labeling: Projects cluster centroids to camera frames via transforms.json, runs YOLOv8 detection, assigns most-voted class label to each cluster
streamlit_application.caching: Gaussian loading and clustering cached via st.cache_data (keyed on splat path) — reruns without re-clustering on UI interaction
streamlit_application.note: App uses older RelationGNN model interface (8-dim node, 4-dim edge). For GeoKAN-Gamma inference in app, would need to update _load_model() to use GeoKANRelationGNN and match 10-dim node / 22-dim edge features.
